g.title: Q-TrafficX — A weather-aware traffic digital twin for a 6-intersection network: signal timing and routing become QUBO problems solved with hybrid QAOA. 181 passing tests. Built with Python, Qiskit Aer, FastAPI, NetworkX, Next.js.
